title: CoDe-CBF: Conformalized Delay-Aware Control Barrier Functions for Decentralized Multi-UAV Swarms
description: Complete reproducibility package for CoDe-CBF, providing real 3D sonic anemometer wind datasets, Holybro x500 empirical downwash profiles, live ROS 2 Humble DDS packet traces, 1,000-seed Monte Carlo benchmarks, and the IEEE manuscript.
